answer_1.quote: Text summarization aims to compress a long input text and generate a condensed summary.
answer_1.outputs: overall summary, user summary, agent summary

answer_2.quote: We employ five widely used automatic metrics to evaluate the above methods. The automatic metrics include: ROUGE-based methods ... BLEU ... BERTScore ... MoverScore

answer_4.quote: We recruit three well-educated volunteers to evaluate the three different types of summaries generated from four methods.
answer_4.guideline: We evaluate the summary quality for each segment in the following three aspects: informativeness, non-redundancy, fluency.
